## 🎯 Hackathon PR Checklist

### 📝 What does this PR do?
- [ ] Frontend enhancement
- [ ] Backend API endpoint / route
- [ ] AI model training / inference update
- [ ] Bug fix / integration

### 🧪 Testing & Verification
- [ ] Code runs locally without errors
- [ ] No large files/weights accidentally committed (weights should go to `.gitignore` or cloud storage)
- [ ] API endpoints verified with Swagger docs (`http://localhost:8000/docs`)
- [ ] Frontend verified at `http://localhost:5173`
